text_block_list.text:
I've waited so long to get my hands on
these...
Now, I can finally—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see Narita Taishin in such a
good
mood.
choice_data_list: ずいぶん楽しそうだな
ずいぶん楽しそうだね
choice_data_list_en: You look like you're having a lot of fun.
You seem to be having a lot of fun, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sitting on the table before her are
various gelatin
cups, juices, and mini
cake bars that claim to be
packed full of
nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What are you staring at? You got a
problem with
me eating healthy food?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...You think so too?
choice_data_list: ああ、成長に役立ちそうだと思って
うん、成長に役立ちそうだと思って
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I thought it'd help with your growth.
Yeah, I thought it'd help with your growth.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just you wait! Soon I'll be
towering over
everybody else!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph.
choice_data_list: 食べすぎないよう気をつけて
よし！栄養ガッツリとろう！
choice_data_list_en: Be careful not to eat too much.
All right! Time to fuel up with nutrients!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't need you to tell me that!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's true, but don't you worry!
choice_data_list: でもタイシンは無理することがあるから

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
She's got Tickezo, Hayahide, and me
keeping an
eye on her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? When'd you get here, Cree—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hang on, I don't need any babysitters!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ You can't blame me, dear. It's
in my
nature to care about others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that Narita Taishin won't be
doing
anything too rash for the time
being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I breathe a sigh of relief as I watch their

back-and-forth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought that if she received the right
amount of
nutrients, it would surely help
her grow taller and
stronger, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Dammit, I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've been working so hard, but I've only
grown
sideways! What's the deal?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taishin... I warned you not to load
up on too
many nutrient-rich foods.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I tried to stop you, but that just
encouraged you
to sneak behind my
back even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, save it! I just thought I'd grow faster
if I ate
more!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It made sense in my head, anyway...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin looks disappointed. The

body-building road proves to be a rather
difficult
one.
